_doc: The values an inlet takes, where Max's reference page states them. Used by maxpylang/devicecheck.py to compare a Live parameter's range with the inlet it reaches. Keyed by Max object name, then inlet index. `hi` may be "sr/4", a quarter of the sample rate, which the check takes at 44.1 kHz. `says` quotes the reference page the limits were read from, so an entry can be checked against Max. Only add an inlet whose page states a range: a guess here becomes a false alarm.

1.says: the center frequency is expressed in Hz, where the allowable range is from 0 to one quarter of the current sampling rate
frequency is expressed in Hz, where the allowable range is from 0 to one fourth of the current sampling rate

2.says: Sets a "resonance factor" between 0 (minimum resonance) and 1 (maximum resonance)

1.says: The drive factor should usually be in the range 1 - 10
Peak value phase offset, expressed as a fraction of a cycle, from 0 to 1.0
